patch_description: This approach combines dual-guided local moves with an adaptive probabilistic model of promising links. Rather than relying mainly on repeated walks from a few parents, it learns link frequencies from a diverse elite of LP-scored networks, samples new raw topologies from those frequencies, and uses the free repair operation to make them valid. It also ranks local 2-switches by their estimated effect on priced bottleneck links. The mix of model-generated candidates and dual-ranked moves is intended to balance broad basin exploration with targeted improvement.
